upstream.subtreeParity: engines/nunc-fluens/app diff-clean against upstream at staging time (code tip 529f2e1; data advanced to the completed 2026-07-05 day)
stagingRules: stage reads `git archive` at the pinned commit, never the working tree — a mid-flight daily run cannot leak into the fixtures
fixture days must be CLOSED days (their daily-master commit exists at the pinned commit)
`stage` and `run` always travel together: restaging without recapturing desynchronizes input/ and expected/

historicalPredictionDates.why: predictions.json only (en + locales) — feeds the tests of the retired one-shot rename-future-titles skill (not DAG-invoked; reclassified out of the port at T1, tests retire with the Python at T12)

normalization.isoTimestamps: every YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.f][Z] in the DB dump and export JSON is rewritten to 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z before storing/comparing (created_at/updated_at/scored_at/generated_at metadata; content never carries time-of-day stamps)
normalization.captureDateTokens: the capture-run date (date-only ISO) is rewritten to <CAPTURE_DAY> in the DB dump and export JSON (glossary first_seen/last_seen, needs extracted_on and similar); the TS parity test applies the same rewrite with its own run date
normalization.workPath: the absolute work/ directory path is rewritten to <WORK> in captured tool output (daily-flow-check prints its repo root)
normalization.jsonNumberFormatting: export JSON parity is asserted on PARSED values, not bytes: python json.dumps writes repr floats (1.0), JS writes 1 — JSON numbers are typeless and every consumer parses the file
normalization.layoutTrigUlp: ring-layout x/y come from sin/cos, which differ between python's libm and V8 in the last ULP; the export parity test rounds layout.x/.y to 9 decimals (they only seed the frontend force layout)

T4c: citation-restriction-check no-op pass on committed data
run-update-pages full rebuild parity (cli export is captured in T1)

notes: Inputs are verbatim copies of committed upstream data for the listed days/window; the work/ tree is disposable and rebuilt by capture.ts run.
Renders are compared byte-for-byte; a sanity diff against the historically committed report files is logged but is not the gate (the gate is oracle-vs-port).
